Name: Cutscene Maker for Content Patcher
Author: Kreestijan
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Cutscene Maker for Content Patcher[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Description[/b]
[line]
Got inspired by this old forum post:  [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/looking-for-a-mod-that-lets-you-make-cutscenes.46632/]Looking for a mod, that lets you make cutscenes. | Stardew Valley Forums[/url]

Cutscene Maker adds a button to the main menu screen of SDV that opens a sort of editor when accessed, this allows you to visually make a cutscene and preview it before exporting it as a Content Patcher mod.
Also supports importing of Content Patcher mods that add cutscenes.

This is only made possible because Content Patcher does the heavy lifting which allows my mod to just export a simple .json so big shoutout for that. <3

This is a very early release but here is a sort of demonstrational video:

[center][youtube]jBfemlPAGfI[/youtube][/center]

The main functionality is there, it could use some polish though, if you need specific features or anything else just ask and I will add it as soon as I can.

[color=#ffffff][b]Tutorial for a Basic Cutscene :[/b][/color]

[list=1]
[*]Open [b]Cutscene Maker[/b] from the title screen button.[/*]
[*]Pick a [b]Location[/b] from the location dropdown (can be changed afterwards but NPC locations will remain at the same tile as before).[/*]
[*]Use right click to drag the map around and reach your preferred spot[/*]
[*]Use the map view to place the farmer by clicking/dragging them.[/*]
[*]Add an NPC from the setup/properties panel, then drag them where you want.[/*]
[*]Add timeline actions with [b]+ Add[/b].[/*]
[/list]Example simple timeline:
[list=1]
[*]Setup: location, farmer position, NPCs.[/*]
[*]Move: make an NPC walk to a tile (have the NPC selected and click a tile for the NPC to reach).[/*]
[*]Speak: NPC says a line.[/*]
[*]Speak: farmer replies (doesn't support choices for now).[/*]
[*]Emote: NPC/farmer shows an emote.[/*]
[*]Pause: wait time in ms.[/*]
[*]End: finish the cutscene.[/*]
[/list][b]Useful Tips[/b]
[list]
[*]Use [b]Play[/b] to preview the cutscene before exporting.[/*]
[*]Use [b]drag/drop[/b] on timeline tiles to reorder actions.[/*]
[*]For cycle buttons, left-click goes forward and right-click goes backwards.[/*]
[*]Leave triggers empty if you want the event to be easy to test in-game, then add real conditions later.[/*]
[/list][b]Export[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Click export/save.[/*]
[*]The mod creates a Content Patcher pack in your Stardew Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Restart the game so SMAPI loads the exported CP pack.[/*]
[*]Go to the selected location to test the event.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Main Features[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*]Make and export cutscenes as a Content Patcher mod directly from the game itself[/*]
[*]Auto loading of NPCs and locations currently in the game, including modded[/*]
[*]Reposition timeline tiles during iteration[/*]
[*]Add/remove triggers for the cutscene[/*]
[*]Select NPC/farmer position and facing[/*]
[*]Import existing cutscenes added with Content Patcher for further editing[/*]
[*]Initial framing centers on the farmer character when the cutscene starts[/*]
[/list]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] -> required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] -> while not technically required by the mod you need it to actually use what you make, obviously[/*]
[/list]

[b]Installation[/b]
[line]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[line]
✅ Built for Stardew Valley 1.6+
✅ Should be compatible with everything, in theory
❌ N/A
